record.question: A godown is in the form of a cuboid of measures 60m×40m×30m. How many cuboidal boxes can be stored in it if the volume of one box is 8 cu.m.?
record.explanation: Godown volume=60×40×30=72,000 m³. Dividing by 8 m³ per box gives 9,000 boxes, option B, under the volume-packing assumption intended by the question; individual box dimensions are not supplied. Verified worked solution; unofficial.
